violation_type.title: Required Personnel Records - Photo Identification (26 TAC §746.901(9))
violation_type.typical_finding: The driver's license copy on file for the center's driver was found to be expired at the time of  inspection.

finding_variants.text: The driver's license copy on file for the center's driver was found to be expired at the time of  inspection.
2 out of 4 staff files evaluated did not contain photo identification.
A total of ten operational staff files were review. One of ten operational staff do not have a current driver license.
One caregiver did not have a copy of photo identification.

There was an employee that did not have their Identification Card in their file.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when the director made a copy of the Identification card, and added it to the file.
One staff file did not include copies of their state issued IDs in their file.
